_description: Metalmeccanica PMI Unionmeccanica-Confapi (CNEL C018) level 5, June 2026 regular run, permanent, full time: the first month of the tranche of 1 June 2026.
_notes: Minimo 5th level 2,195.87 from 1 September 2025 and 2,245.87 from 1 June 2026 (accordo 24 July 2025, ratified 25 September 2025; table reprinted in the renewal of 4 June 2026, p.5, ratified 23 July 2026).
The verbale of 17 June 2026 finds the IPCA 2025 (1.9%) below the June 2026 tranche: the minimo stays 2,245.87.
Base salary only: allowances, seniority and the gross depend on facts outside the national table.

source.document: Verbale di accordo Unionmeccanica Confapi - Fim-Cisl, Fiom-Cgil, Uilm-Uil, 17 giugno 2026 (minimi dal 1 giugno 2026)
